custom_all_sections.yaml@set.check:
version: 1
repo:
  path: <CONFIG_DIR>
  base_branch: develop
  dags_dir: airflow/dags
  tests_dir: tests
  test_command: python -m pytest -q -x
  allowed_paths:
  - src/
  pytest_timeout: 120
airflow:
  api_url: http://airflow-apiserver:8080
  username: svc-healer
  password: '***'
monitor:
  dags:
  - sales_*
  - customers_*
  - '!*_tmp'
  modes:
  - rest
  - callback
  poll_interval_seconds: 45
  trigger: every_failure
contracts:
  dir: contracts
datasets:
  sales_daily_etl:
    extract_sales:
      type: csv
      path: data/in/sales.csv
      options:
        sep: ;
    load_sales:
      type: parquet
      path: data/out/sales.parquet
      options: {}
  inventory_report:
    get_inventory:
      type: json
      path: data/inventory.jsonl
      options:
        lines: true
classification:
  min_confidence: 0.6
notify:
  email:
    host: mailpit
    port: 1025
    from: Healer <healer@example.com>
    to:
    - a@example.com
    - B Team <b@example.com>
    starttls: false
    username: mailer
    password: '***'
  events:
  - reported
  - repaired
github:
  repo: acme/etl
  pr_base: develop
  token: '***'
llm:
  provider: fake
  model: claude-opus-5-5
  effort: medium
  max_tokens: 8000
  fallbacks: false
limits:
  max_fix_attempts: 2
  max_incidents_per_hour: 5
  max_tokens_per_incident: 200000
  max_diff_files: 4
  max_diff_lines: 150
masking:
  default: redact
  columns:
  - email
  allow:
  - id
  - country
  hook: acme.masks:mask
  sample_rows: 3
store:
  url: postgresql+psycopg2://healer:***@postgres/healer
ingest:
  token: '***'
  api_url: http://airflow-apiserver:8080
debug: true
derived:
  source_path: <CONFIG_DIR>/custom_all_sections.yaml
  repo_root: <CONFIG_DIR>
  dags_path: <CONFIG_DIR>/airflow/dags
  contracts_dir: <CONFIG_DIR>/contracts
  healer_home: <HEALER_HOME>
  database_url: postgresql+psycopg2://healer:***@postgres/healer
